verses.text: Can you pull in Leviathan with a fishhook, or tie down its tongue with a rope?
Can you put a rope through its nose, or a hook through its jaw?
Will it keep begging you for mercy? Will it speak gently to you?
Will it make an agreement with you to be your slave for life?
Can you play with it as you would with a bird? Can you put it on a leash for your girls?
Will traders bargain over it? Will they divide it up among the merchants?
Can you fill its skin with harpoons, or its head with fishing spears?
Put your hand on it once, and you will remember the fight. You will never do it again!
Any hope of beating it is useless. Just seeing it makes a person fall down in fear.
No one is fierce enough to wake it up. Then who can stand up against me?
Who has given me anything that I must pay back? Everything under the sky belongs to me.
I will not stay quiet about its legs, its great strength, and its fine body.
Who can strip off its outer coat? Who would come near its open jaws?
Who dares to open its mouth? Its teeth all around are terrifying.
Its back has rows of shields, tightly sealed together.
Each one is so close to the next that no air can pass between them.
They are joined to each other. They stick together and cannot be pulled apart.
When it sneezes, light flashes. Its eyes are like the first light of dawn.
Burning torches stream from its mouth. Sparks of fire shoot out.
Smoke pours from its nose, like steam from a boiling pot over burning reeds.
Its breath sets coals on fire. Flames shoot out of its mouth.
Its neck is very strong. Terror goes ahead of it.
The folds of its flesh are joined tightly together. They are firm and cannot be moved.
Its heart is as hard as a rock, as hard as a lower millstone.
When it rises up, the mighty are afraid. They run away from its thrashing.
A sword that strikes it does no harm. Neither does a spear, a dart, or an arrow.
It treats iron like straw and bronze like rotten wood.
Arrows do not make it run away. Stones from a sling are like bits of straw to it.
It thinks clubs are like straw. It laughs at the sound of a spear flying at it.
Its belly is covered with sharp pieces like broken pottery. It leaves a trail in the mud like a threshing sledge.
It makes the deep water boil like a pot. It stirs up the sea like a pot of ointment.
It leaves a shining trail behind it. You would think the deep sea had white hair.
Nothing on earth is equal to it. It was made to have no fear.
It looks down on everything that is proud. It is king over all the proud beasts."
